title: Parcel X-Ray Night Shift

errors.message: Blueprint-required reusable component scripts and the inspection xray_box interaction script are not attached to their declared nodes in the final game scene.
Multiple Blueprint state, variant, transition, state_binding and enabled_when symbols referenced by the approved Blueprint are absent from the attached AppRoot script.
Inspection Rule Manual entry and Pause entry are not wired from the live inspection scene, so required overlay/session routes are not reachable from gameplay.
Live rule functions change source values/meaning: combo bonus, failure model, hazard logic, false-pin, wrong-pass, wrong-other and efficiency values differ from Game Design.
Scan handling enforces a hard four-scan cap although Game Design defines soft_target=4, hard_limit=null, with efficiency penalty starting at the fifth scan.
Evidence pinning records arbitrary tap positions after scanning instead of resolving taps against a visible internal X-ray shape as required.

The scene-attached gameplay path uses case_index modulo routing and simplified scoring rather than the source hazard evaluator/scoring semantics; a fuller unattached main.gd cannot substitute for the live scene path.
Result/summary presentation is incomplete: explanation is stored as tooltip text and critical/efficiency summary fields are not populated by the live AppRoot flow.

limitation: Static connector-native review only; no Godot runtime claim. Failed static/semantic review does not produce passing Gate evidence.
